reason: Spinneys and Tawfeer are five minutes from my house, so I can go myself and see the price on the shelf. I don't see why I'd hand my list to a stranger and take their word for the receipt.
objection: How do I know they really paid the cheap price and didn't add a markup? All I get is a bag and a number, and I'd have to trust them on it.
would_change_my_mind: They send me a photo of the till receipt with my items on the voice note, and the first two bags show I paid less than I would have in the shop even after the $2 fee.
